name: workflow
description: Coordinator, minimal-code posture, final review cycle with separate critic coverage, and Fallow-backed simplification review for engineering workflow. Works best with Superpowers installed.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinator, minimal-code posture, final review cycle with separate critic coverage, and simplification review for engineering workflow.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate engineering work through explicit planning and implementation workflows, use a minimal-code posture for small readable changes, run review cycles that include separate critic review before completion claims, and use Fallow-backed simplification review for cleanup and maintainability analysis. Works best with Superpowers installed and falls back clearly when Superpowers is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow:coordinator for planning and implementation coordination.
Use $workflow:minimal-code as the default implementation lens for small, readable, low-ceremony changes.
Use $workflow:review-cycle after meaningful edits as the final acceptance gate, confirming separate critic review before acceptance unless a narrow fast-path skip applies.
